claim_en: No FDR-level adult peripheral-blood OSA consensus program exists (Step 3)
claim_zh: 成人外周血不存在 FDR 层 OSA 共识程序（Step 3）
basis_en: Backbone cohorts significantly anti-correlated (perm p<1e-4); concordance significantly below chance; held-out validation independently concurs.
basis_zh: 主干队列显著反相关（置换 p<1e-4）；一致率显著低于随机；留出验证独立印证。

claim_en: P283 is the most solid program asset: single-cohort FDR program with CPAP normalisation and monocyte localisation (Steps 3/4)
claim_zh: P283 是最实的程序资产：单队列 FDR 程序，具 CPAP 正常化与单核定位（Step 3/4）
basis_en: Held-out validation failed and reversed (concordance 0.175, d=−1.22). Corrected calibre: “single-cohort internally consistent, cross-cohort irreproducible”. Its within-cohort evidence stands on its own.
basis_zh: 留出验证未通过且方向反转（一致率 0.175，d=−1.22）。修正口径：“单队列内自洽、跨队列不可复现”。其队列内证据本身站立。

claim_en: NOM18 is a nominal-tier set only (Step 3)
claim_zh: NOM18 仅为名义层集合（Step 3）
basis_en: Held-out not supported (0.231); pooled permutation p=0.043 is nominal and single-design driven; never load-bearing.
basis_zh: 留出不支持（0.231）；合并置换 p=0.043 为名义且单设计驱动；从不承重。

claim_en: No FDR cell-fraction difference in blood deconvolution (Step 3)
claim_zh: 血液去卷积无 FDR 细胞分数差异（Step 3）
basis_en: No check overturned it; no old-platform exposure on the human side.
basis_zh: 五项检查无推翻；人类侧无老平台暴露。

claim_en: Program scores track monocyte fraction/state (Steps 3/4)
claim_zh: 程序分数追踪单核细胞分数/状态（Step 3/4）
basis_en: Two steps mutually corroborate; see H12 for the statistic caveat.
basis_zh: 两步互证维持；统计量注记见 H12。

claim_en: CPAP reversal concentrates in GSE283703; it is not a general phenomenon (Step 3)
claim_zh: CPAP 逆转集中于 GSE283703，非普遍现象（Step 3）
basis_en: Gene-set permutation: P283 pooled p=0.149; only the GSE283703 long-term design is significant (p=0.0135).
basis_zh: 基因集置换：P283 合并 p=0.149；仅 GSE283703 长期设计显著（p=0.0135）。

claim_en: Acute IH and chronic OSA are decoupled at the gene level (Step 3 bridge)
claim_zh: 急性 IH 与慢性 OSA 在基因层脱耦（Step 3 桥）
basis_en: Cross-species version strengthened separately as H20.
basis_zh: 跨物种版另行加强为 H20。

claim_en: Adipose Tier B (1,408 genes) is a cross-cohort consensus (Step 3)
claim_zh: 脂肪 Tier B（1,408 基因）是跨队列共识（Step 3）
basis_en: 0/1,408 genes have FDR support in GSE38792; the set rests solely on the globally shifted GSE135917. Reclassified as a GSE135917 single-cohort set; its WGCNA modules downgraded with it.
basis_zh: 0/1,408 基因在 GSE38792 有 FDR 支撑；集合只靠全局平移的 GSE135917。改判为 GSE135917 单队列集；其 WGCNA 模块连带降级。

claim_en: Adenoid severity gradient is FDR-null; nominal signal points to T cells (Step 4)
claim_zh: 腺样体严重度梯度 FDR 为零、名义信号指向 T 细胞（Step 4）
basis_en: GSE274855 compilation is a non-replication, consistent with a weak tissue-layer signal.
basis_zh: GSE274855 归集为不复现，与组织层弱信号一致。

claim_en: CellChat MIF–CD74 axis weakens in severe disease (exploratory, Step 4)
claim_zh: CellChat MIF–CD74 轴在重度减弱（探索性，Step 4）
basis_en: No new test in Step 7; exploratory calibre unchanged.
basis_zh: 本步无新检验，探索口径不变。

claim_en: The tonsil cohort does not replicate the adenoid program (Step 4)
claim_zh: 扁桃体队列不复现腺样体程序（Step 4）
basis_en: Compilation completed; the “vs healthy” readout is not computable by design (no healthy arm).
basis_zh: 归集完成；“对健康”读数因无健康臂在设计上不可计算。

claim_en: P283 localises to CD14 monocytes (Step 4)
claim_zh: P283 定位于 CD14 单核（Step 4）
basis_en: Mean-shift permutation p=0.15 vs rank test p=0.0046 — both statistics must be reported together; localisation is valid only within its source-cohort context (see H2).
basis_zh: 均值移位置换 p=0.15 与秩检验 p=0.0046 须并列报告；定位仅在来源队列语境內有效（见 H2）。

claim_en: Mouse hippocampus has a true 100-gene two-cohort consensus (Step 5)
claim_zh: 小鼠海马有 100 基因双队列真共识（Step 5）
basis_en: LOO formalisation confirms intersection character (Jaccard 0.07–0.10); the genome-wide ρ≈0 caveat stands alongside.
basis_zh: 留一形式化确认交集性质（Jaccard 0.07–0.10）；全基因组 ρ≈0 的注记并行维持。

claim_en: Mouse liver strict consensus is empty; the 46-gene set is sensitivity-tier only (Step 5)
claim_zh: 小鼠肝严格共识为空；46 基因仅作敏感性集（Step 5）
basis_en: LOO: any leave-one-out is non-empty (3–19 genes) — “empty” is a property of the full four-cohort gate; the 46-gene set's composition is cohort-sensitive (LOO survivors 3–19).
basis_zh: 留一：任一留一非空（3–19）——“空”是四队列全门的性质；46 集成成分对队列构成敏感（留一存活 3–19）。

claim_en: At chronic endpoints the hypoxia program is down, not up; only 3 pathway-grid cells pass FDR (Step 5)
claim_zh: 慢性终点低氧程序不升反降；通路网格仅 3 格 FDR（Step 5）
basis_en: Not old-platform dependent; but gene-mean logFC ≈ 0 (Step 7 P5) — wording is restricted to the ssGSEA score level.
basis_zh: 不依赖老平台；但基因平均 logFC ≈ 0（Step 7 P5）——表述限定为 ssGSEA 分数层面。

claim_en: The rat-lung response concentrates at day 7 (Step 5, GSE8705)
claim_zh: 大鼠肺反应集中于第 7 天（Step 5，GSE8705）
basis_en: Rests entirely on a 2008 microarray platform; downgraded to a registry-level description with platform year attached.
basis_zh: 完全依赖 2008 年芯片平台；降级为登记层描述并注平台年代。

claim_en: Background-layer fidelity grading at the gene layer: P301S preserves/amplifies, 5XFAD abolishes (Step 5)
claim_zh: 背景层基因层保真分级：P301S 保留/扩增、5XFAD 废除（Step 5）
basis_en: Permutation supports the gene-layer units; the pre-existing note that this does not reproduce at the pathway layer stands.
basis_zh: 置换支持基因层单元；其在通路层不复现的既有注记维持。

claim_en: Kidney effect is proximal-tubule-led; genioglossus is descriptive-only (Step 5)
claim_zh: 肾脏近端小管主导效应；颏舌肌仅描述层（Step 5）
basis_en: No check touched these items.
basis_zh: 五项检查无涉。

claim_en: Pathway fidelity: no combination is significant; the ranking is positional only (Step 6)
claim_zh: 通路保真度：无组合显著、排序仅位置意义（Step 6）
basis_en: Settled: the permutation space is 24 by design (4 programs), minimum one-sided p ≈ 0.042; animal-side LOO is stable. F-05 closed.
basis_zh: 定案：置换空间 24 由设计常数决定（4 程序），单侧 p 下限 ≈ 0.042；动物侧留一稳定。F-05 关闭。

claim_en: Acute–chronic decoupling is cross-species (Step 6)
claim_zh: 急性–慢性脱耦跨物种成立（Step 6）
basis_en: Animal LOO 0/52 flips; unchanged without old platforms; load-bearing cells (Hypoxia, Oxidative stress) invariant. Circadian/Inflammation signs depend on the human reference cohort, and the heart cell has no modern chronic counterpart after old-platform exclusion — all three caveats are mandatory in the manuscript.
basis_zh: 动物留一 0/52 翻转；剔老平台不变；承重格（低氧、氧化）全口径不变。昼夜/炎症符号依人类参照队列而定，心脏格剔老平台后无现代慢性对应——三点注记稿件必须写入。

claim_en: Gene-layer transfer: P283 × mouse lung significant; adenoid nominal transfer, etc. (Step 6)
claim_zh: 基因层迁移：P283 × 小鼠肺显著；腺样体名义迁移等（Step 6）
basis_en: All confirmed at 10,000 permutations (p from 0.0033 to <1e-4).

claim_en: CPAP vs animal recovery arms are an asymmetric description only (Step 6)
claim_zh: CPAP 与动物恢复臂仅作不对称描述（Step 6）
basis_en: Design-asymmetry calibre maintained.
basis_zh: 设计不对称口径维持。
